title: Supporters and Skeptics: LLM-based Analysis of Engagement with Mental Health (Mis)Information Content on Video-sharing Platforms
reasoning: The paper includes a substantial analysis of how religious language and faith-centered perspectives correlate with engagement with mental health misinformation. It uses specific LIWC categories and SAGE n-grams to identify and discuss religious themes (e.g., keywords like 'jesus', 'pray', 'lord') and benchmarks LLMs on their ability to classify these and related stigmatizing discourses.
